_comment: Grandfather Knot's second errand (docs/plan-grandfather-knot.md), offered only after clear-the-grove is completed: his roots hum the Glimmerwood calm, but three have fallen asleep, so the young treants have turned angry. Wake the three roots ONE AT A TIME, returning to him between each. The first leg starts on accept; the next two are objective stages ENTERED FROM A DIALOGUE ROW (grandfather-knot.json), so entering one re-baselines its talk_to and an early talk does not count. Turn-in: EntanglingRoots + 1000 XP. Journal text stays plain; only the tree carries a voice.
title: The Sleeping Roots

stages.journal: Grandfather Knot's roots calm the treants of the Glimmerwood, but three of them have fallen asleep. Wake the root by the stream, west of him.

objectives.tracker: Wake the root by the stream

stages.journal: The root by the stream is awake.
Wake the root by the stones, south of Grandfather Knot.

objectives.tracker: Wake the root by the stones

stages.journal: The root by the stones is awake.
Wake the last root, east of Grandfather Knot where the wisps gather.
